scripts.deploy-all: docker ps --filter name=sui-fork --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q "${SANDBOX_STACK:-deepbook-sandbox}" || { echo 'devstack fork stack is not running — run `pnpm stack:up` in another terminal first (it stays attached)'; exit 1; }; docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.stack:up: pnpm -C devstack-plugins install --ignore-workspace && pnpm -C devstack-plugins exec devstack up
scripts.stack:wipe: pnpm -C devstack-plugins install --ignore-workspace && pnpm -C devstack-plugins exec devstack wipe --stack ${SANDBOX_STACK:-deepbook-sandbox}
